north_star: A source-grounded, natural-sounding, one-tap morning consciousness training platform that works reliably on iPhone with zero recurring API cost and preserves user data and evidence.

deliverables.name: Immediate morning-practice continuity
deliverables.acceptance_remaining: Ryan physically runs the shortest iPhone/PWA morning, cold-offline, support-audio, marker, and complete-return gate.

deliverables.name: Natural voice recovery
deliverables.acceptance_remaining: Ryan selects A, B, C, or NONE by physical human naturalness judgment.

deliverables.name: Source-grounded selected-voice Day 1 production experience
deliverables.acceptance_remaining: After a candidate passes: five-minute selected-voice physical gate, then one natural 25-minute physical gate.

deliverables.name: Breath Director and Breath Foundations
deliverables.acceptance_remaining: Physical iPhone eyes-open/eyes-closed usability, stop, interruption, and safety acceptance.

deliverables.name: Protocol hardening and State Atlas
deliverables.acceptance_remaining: Real user evidence and feedback remain required; elapsed time and timer completion do not prove state attainment.

deliverables.name: User-friendly and exciting mobile experience
deliverables.acceptance_remaining: Physical installed-iPhone safe-area, touch, icon, audio, lifecycle, and cold-offline acceptance.

deliverables.name: Controlled source tracks
deliverables.acceptance_remaining: Broader source-track content remains held to source review; Foundation Days 2 through 112 remain unauthored.

deliverables.name: Local-first AI, transcription, voice capture, and data reliability
deliverables.acceptance_remaining: Actual-origin preservation and real iPhone microphone, reconnect, quota, large-binary, interruption, and recovery gates.

deliverables.name: Rev3 verification and deployment package
deliverables.acceptance_remaining: Exact pushed candidate staging, isolated private preview, draft PR, physical gates, and explicit release authority.

next_controlled_action: Ryan listens blind to the exact A, B, and C short samples on iPhone at one unchanged volume and reports Best: A, B, C, or NONE plus one short observation.
